title: Kids story - The Little Boat and the Storm

parts.style: warm, gentle bedtime welcome, a soft smile in the voice, speaking slowly
parts.text: Good evening, sleepyhead. <short pause> Snuggle down under your blanket... <short pause> because tonight's story happens on a little boat, out on a big lake, on a very windy evening.

Once upon a time, a girl named Mia lived with her grandpa in a small blue house beside a lake. <short pause> Grandpa had a little wooden boat called Daisy, with a white sail and a bell that went ding when the waves rocked it.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: One afternoon, Mia and Grandpa took Daisy out onto the water. <short pause> The lake was smooth and shiny. <short pause> Ducks paddled by. <short pause> Mia trailed her fingers in the cool water, and Grandpa hummed a slow, happy song.

But as the sun went lower, the sky turned gray. <short pause> The wind began to blow. <short pause> Whoosh. <short pause> Little waves became bigger waves. <short pause> Daisy rocked up... and down... and up again. <short pause> Ding, ding, went the little bell.
Mia held on tight. <short pause> Grandpa, she said in a small voice, I'm scared. <short pause> What do we do?

Grandpa didn't shout, and he didn't hurry. <short pause> He put one warm hand on Mia's shoulder. <short pause> I'm right here, he said. <short pause> First, we take a slow breath together. <short pause> Then we row home, nice and steady.

So they breathed together. <short pause> In through the nose, slow and deep... <short pause> and out through the mouth, like blowing out a candle. <short pause> In... <short pause> and out. <short pause> And Mia's heart, which had been beating fast, began to slow down.

Grandpa lowered the sail and took the oars. <short pause> Row... and rest. <short pause> Row... and rest. <short pause> Mia counted with him. <short pause> One, two. <short pause> One, two. <short pause> And little by little, Daisy turned toward home.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: Then something wonderful happened. <short pause> The wind grew softer. <short pause> The waves grew smaller. <short pause> The gray clouds drifted apart, and behind them was a sky full of stars. <short pause> The lake became smooth and still again, like a mirror.

parts.style: tender, quiet storytelling, a soft smile in the voice
parts.text: Look, Mia, said Grandpa. <short pause> Storms always pass. <short pause> And when they do, the sky is still there, waiting. <short pause> Mia smiled, and the little bell gave one last, sleepy ding.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: Back at the blue house, Grandpa wrapped Mia in a fluffy towel and made her a mug of warm milk. <short pause> She curled up in bed, listening to the gentle lap of the water outside her window.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Sometimes, little one, our feelings can be like that windy lake. <short pause> Big worries. <short pause> Fast heartbeats. <short pause> But you can do what Mia did. <short pause> Take a slow breath... <short pause> remember who loves you... <short pause> and wait for the calm. <short pause> It always comes.
Let's breathe like Mia now. <short pause> Breathe in... <short pause> and breathe out. <short pause> Once more. <short pause> In... <short pause> and out.
The wind is quiet now. <short pause> The water is still. <short pause> And you are safe and warm in your bed. <short pause> Goodnight, sleepyhead.
